//: THIS CONFIG TYPECHECKS ONLY — noEmit, no build output. Node 22.6+/24 strips
types and runs the .ts files directly, which is the same mode tests/ and
scripts/migrate/ already run the app's TypeScript in. A tsc emit would not
help anyway: the shared guards this service imports reach their siblings
with extensionless specifiers (`./keys`, CLAUDE.md's house rule) and tsc
does not rewrite those into something Node's ESM resolver can follow.
It deliberately does NOT extend the root tsconfig: that one carries jsx,
the DOM lib and Next's plugin, none of which belong in a server with no
browser and no Next. It repeats the compiler options it needs instead.
`include` reaches OUT of this folder for the two shared modules. That is the
point of the refactor they came from — the gateway grades the same source
the app grades, so a change to a guard cannot typecheck here and fail there.
